steps: Warm the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and red pepper and cook until soft, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika and cumin and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes, season with salt and simmer for 10 minutes until slightly thickened.
Make six wells in the sauce and crack the eggs into them. Cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes, until the whites are set.
Scatter over the feta and parsley. Serve from the pan with crusty bread.

steps: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted water until just tender. Save a cup of the pasta water.
Melt the butter with the zest and juice of the lemons.
Toss the spaghetti in the pan with the parmesan and a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Finish with basil and plenty of black pepper.
Whisk the flour, sugar and baking powder.
Whisk the buttermilk, eggs and browned butter.
Stir the two together until just mixed.
Cook on a hot buttered griddle and serve with blueberries and maple syrup.
Blend the frozen berries with half the banana.
Top with fresh berries, granola, the rest of the banana and honey.
